verdict.rationale: VLP's Emerging Growth Companies & VC practice explicitly lists entity formation, capitalization, corporate governance and equity matters as core services. That practice represents angel-backed, venture-backed and self-funded start-ups, and documents are drafted by seasoned attorneys. Missing for 10: the specific formation deliverables (charter, bylaws, initial board consents, founder stock purchase agreements) are never itemized, and there is no independent or client corroboration of the formation work.
